THE LOW T EPIDEMIC…

Testosterone levels in men have been steadily declining for decades- dropping up to 1% per year since the late ’80s. This isn’t just about libido or muscle mass. Low T is linked to fatigue, brain fog, depression, insulin resistance, increased body fat, and poor sleep.

The culprits? Endocrine-disrupting chemicals in skincare and plastics, chronic stress, poor sleep, pornography, nutrient deficiencies, and the overconsumption of seed oils and processed foods. Testosterone is foundational for physical vitality and mental clarity and fertility/ Stabilizing it isn’t about chasing a number; it’s about protecting your long-term health, resilience, and biological integrity BOYSS 🩵
